facts.fact: The IDS Malawi country report states that the National Registration Act of 2010 makes the National Registration Bureau the authority responsible for civil registration, and that the Bureau began operating in 2017 under the ministry now called Homeland Security, overseeing civil registration.

systems.owner: National Registration Bureau (NRB), under the Ministry of Homeland Security

systems.tiers: national; 12.5 million registered as of May 2025

note: The Malawi passages cover the biometric national ID and its law; beyond naming the Bureau as the civil registration authority they describe no civil registration system and nothing on how any office records a birth or death.
